## 1. Title & Identity Sanitization Quality

- [x] CHK001 Are platform branding suffix tokens explicitly enumerated or bounded in the requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Does the specification define behavior for destinations with legitimate hyphens versus platform separator hyphens? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, Edge Cases]

## 2. Knowledge Enrichment & Wikipedia Resolution Quality

- [x] CHK005 Are canonical Wikipedia URL resolution requirements defined when direct title matching fails? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Does the specification specify fallback behavior when an entity has no Wikipedia presence? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 3. Interactive Mini-Map & Coordinate Reselection Quality

- [x] CHK007 Are both click-to-place and pin-dragging interactions specified for coordinate reselection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK008 Is the timing and debounce trigger for reverse-geocoding upon pin adjustment defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK009 Are boundary requirements defined for coordinate reselection in offshore, unaddressed, or remote areas? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 4. Link & Media Verification Controls Quality

- [x] CHK011 Are "View" verification button states (enabled, disabled, target tab) specified for both URL inputs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK012 Is the in-memory client-side preflight verification probe requirement for hero images explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Clarifications]

## 5. Address Normalization & Country Accuracy Quality

- [x] CHK015 Is reverse-geocoding defined as the authoritative source of truth over raw on-page text when coordinates are present? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK016 Are non-alphanumeric icon glyphs (e.g. `🖈`, `📍`) explicitly targeted for stripping in address normalization? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK017 Does the specification define how contradictory multi-country strings are resolved to a single sovereign country? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, SC-003]
- [x] CHK018 Is the elimination of hardcoded country defaults explicitly documented in requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014]

## 6. Vetted Tags & Duration Estimation Quality

- [x] CHK019 Are taxonomy matching criteria defined for mapping destination categories to vetted tags? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK020 Is the fallback behavior specified when a user has zero custom tags in their personal library? [Completeness, Gap]

- [x] CHK022 Are numeric ranges and units (hours: float, days: int) explicitly bounded in requirements? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017, Key Entities]
